newsitem.title: ALBANIA: GREEKS BRIEFLY SHUT BORDER CROSSING WITH ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: GREEKS BRIEFLY SHUT BORDER CROSSING WITH ALBANIA.

text.p: The Greek consulate in the border town of Gjirokaster and the main crossing into Greece were closed on Wednesday after a fresh wave of violence, residents said.

In Athens, Greek foreign ministry sources said the closures were not permanent and it was hoped to reopen the consulate on Thursday. They said the action was being taken whenever there was a threat of spreading violence.
It was the second time the consulate had been shut down due to security fears, according to town residents.

Albanian officials were not available to confirm the border crossing had been shut but one resident said fighting between gangs of Albanians had forced the Greeks to close the crossing to prevent the violence spreading.
Albania was plunged into lawlessness and chaos in February and March after pyramid investment schemes collapsed.
Although the situation is now calmer, sporadic acts of violence keep flaring up, fuelled by the estimated million or so weapons which people looted during the riots.
